svg.title: Finite attenuation is invertible; a true steady-state null needs different information
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Finite attenuation is invertible; a true steady-state null needs different information
|H_B(0)|=0.9(1−a); desired input 10 mV; DC phasor noise 20 μV RMS
DC phasor regularization at a=0.98: λ is a response-scale penalty
Regularization limits noise gain by retaining bias; it is not full desired-response recovery.
At a=1, constant steady-state inputs are indistinguishable without another observation.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
